title: Monotonic stack: next greater element
summary: For each value, find the next value to its right that is bigger, in one pass with a stack.
note: Values are 0 or more; -1 means no greater value comes later.

panels.label: Stack: values still waiting (top is last)

narration.text: Every answer starts as -1: no greater value found yet.
There are no values, so there are no answers.
The stack will hold positions that are still waiting for a greater value.
{x} is bigger than {nums[stack[-1]]} on top of the stack, so {x} is that value's answer.
The stack is empty: nothing is waiting.
{nums[stack[-1]]} on top isn't smaller than {x}, so stop popping.
The next greater value after {nums[j]} is {x}.
Push position {i}: {x} now waits for a greater value.
